![Christmas Proposal • Black Oak Mountain Vineyards](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-0f07065492f0:4)
You can find a list of festive plans and tips on [The Knot](https://www.theknot.com/content/cliche-holiday-marriage-proposals) to help you design a memorable holiday engagement.

### Cozy at-Home Ideas

- **Tree Ornament:** Hang a custom ornament or the ring box securely on a branch for them to spot while decorating.
- **Stocking Surprise:** Slide the ring box to the very bottom of their Christmas stocking as a final morning surprise.
- **Movie Night:** Set up a festive movie marathon with hot cocoa and fairy lights before asking the question.

### Scenic & Public Outings

- **Christmas Tree Farm:** Walk through the rows of trees to find a quiet, picturesque spot to drop to one knee.
- **Light Display:** Stroll through a local neighborhood or a city display with warm drinks and propose under the glowing lights.
- **Ice Skating:** Take a few festive turns around a local ice rink before asking your partner to marry you.

If you'd like, tell me:

- Do you prefer a **public or private** setting?
- Is **family** going to be around?

I can give you a more customized plan!
